about: R6d: labelled user turns for fact_harvest.tier0 (`keepfold eval harvest-facts`). A made-up person (Meera, a data analyst in Kochi); no real data. `expect` lists the facts a turn states about its writer, worded as about-me lines; a turn of any other kind expects none, except a negation, which expects its negated line. An extracted fact is right when its content words (review._bag) and polarity equal an expected one's.
